security_audit.summary: The backtick findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code and code fence parsing, not shell execution. The skill does read OpenAI API configuration from environment and application settings, and it generates runnable Python code from user-provided context, so publication should require clear sandbox and credential handling guidance.

remediation.issue: The skill reads API keys and base URL values from environment variables and application settings.
remediation.suggestion: Document exactly which credentials are read, avoid logging them, and restrict base_url to trusted endpoints before passing an API key.

remediation.issue: The skill returns model-generated Python intended for sandbox execution.
remediation.suggestion: Require isolated execution with network and filesystem limits, and review generated code before running it on sensitive data.

content.value_statement: Teams often need quick analysis scripts and consistent charts from structured data. This skill generates Python workflows using pandas, NumPy, matplotlib, and seaborn for sandboxed review.
actual_capabilities: Generates Python scripts for data analysis tasks.
Uses pandas and NumPy for cleaning, filtering, and aggregation.
Creates matplotlib and seaborn chart code.
Applies a shared visualization helper for consistent chart styling.
Extracts Python code blocks from model responses for sandbox use.
limitations: Requires a configured OpenAI-compatible API key and endpoint.
Generated code should be reviewed before execution.
Execution safety depends on the surrounding sandbox controls.
The skill does not validate data quality by itself.

use_cases.title: Explore a CSV dataset
use_cases.description: Generate a pandas workflow that profiles columns, summarizes missing values, and prepares charts for review.

use_cases.title: Create presentation visuals
use_cases.description: Build chart scripts that use consistent styling for reports, notebooks, or generated documents.

use_cases.title: Prototype analysis automation
use_cases.description: Turn a plain language analysis requirement into a runnable Python script for a controlled sandbox.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a small dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this dataset context and create a simple Python script that summarizes key columns and missing values. Include one clear chart.

prompt_templates.title: Compare groups in tabular data
prompt_templates.prompt: Create analysis code that groups the data by the named category, compares the main metric across groups, and saves a readable bar chart.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate trends over time
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for time series exploration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a Python analysis script that parses the date column, aggregates the metric by month, highlights trend changes, and saves a line chart.

prompt_templates.title: Build a chart-ready analysis workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with cleaning, aggregation, and visualization needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the supplied data context to create a complete sandbox-ready analysis script. Clean invalid rows, compute grouped metrics, and produce one publication-quality visualization.

output_examples.input: A sales table with region, date, revenue, and product category columns.
output_examples.output: A Python analysis workflow that groups revenue by region and category, reports missing values, and saves a styled comparison chart.

output_examples.input: A customer activity dataset with signup date, plan, and monthly usage fields.
output_examples.output: A time-based analysis plan with monthly aggregation, plan-level comparisons, and a line chart for usage trends.

output_examples.input: A survey export with rating columns and free-form labels.
output_examples.output: A cleaning and visualization workflow that summarizes response distributions and creates a readable heatmap.

best_practices: Run generated scripts only in a sandbox with limited file and network access.
Provide clear column names, data types, and the exact question to answer.
Review generated analysis steps before using results in business decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not run generated code directly on sensitive production systems.
Do not include secrets or private customer data in the analysis prompt.
Do not assume generated charts prove causation without statistical review.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates Python analysis and visualization scripts using pandas, NumPy, matplotlib, and seaborn.

faq.question: Does it execute the generated code?
faq.answer: The reviewed files generate code for sandbox use. Safe execution depends on the host environment.

faq.question: Which credentials does it need?
faq.answer: It uses an OpenAI-compatible API key and optional base URL from configuration or environment variables.

faq.question: Can it analyze any file type?
faq.answer: The skill is oriented toward structured data context. File loading support depends on the surrounding application.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude Code, Claude, and Codex as supported tools.

faq.question: How should I review the output?
faq.answer: Check the cleaning steps, aggregation logic, chart labels, and sandbox controls before running or sharing results.
